This is a very light scan: Lines 1 and 2 Column A are faint and read '$35.00' — Line 2 especially (low) — but Lines 4 and 6 repeat 35.00 clearly, and the balance chain confirms it (274.94 + 35.00 = 309.94; minus 35.00 = 274.94). Column B is blank on both lines. The report-type checkbox is a faint tick beside (not inside) 'Seven days before a general election'; no other period box is marked, and the 10/26/10 date fits that filing (medium).
